name: Alchemy
trainers: Profession trainers in capital cities and many towns
changes: Every profession caps at 300 (Apprentice 75 / Journeyman 150 / Expert 225 / Artisan 300). No passive profession combat bonuses; Legacy perks Working Overtime (up to 5 ranks, +4% skill-up chance per the guide) and Dedicated Study (1 rank, daily: +1 skill to your lowest tradeskill, or 2-4 Elemental Essences once all are 300) apply. 66 new recipes. The six standard Healing Potions moved to First Aid; Alchemy instead gets a Discolored Healing Potion line (heals, then returns part of it as damage over time). Camp objects: Mana Well (skill 20, mana regen like Blessing of Wisdom), Fermenter (Blueprint from Rath'mael, Ruins of Lordaeron), Alchemy Laboratory (tier 3).
levelingTips: Pair with Herbalism; most of the route is herbs (Stranglekelp, Peacebloom, Gromsblood). Roughly 335-390 crafts to 300.

name: Herbalism
trainers: Profession trainers in towns; can also be picked up from a starting-zone gathering quest (Horde: The Barrens, Alliance: Elwynn Forest per RankedBoost)
changes: Every profession caps at 300 (Apprentice 75 / Journeyman 150 / Expert 225 / Artisan 300). No passive profession combat bonuses; Legacy perks Working Overtime (up to 5 ranks, +4% skill-up chance per the guide) and Dedicated Study (1 rank, daily: +1 skill to your lowest tradeskill, or 2-4 Elemental Essences once all are 300) apply. Tauren Cultivation reworked: Tauren can harvest herbs without the skill (and get double yield if they have Herbalism, per Warcraft Tavern; RankedBoost describes it as growing a nearby herb once per herb). Legacy perk Bountiful Harvest gives more Scarce materials. Camp objects: Incense Candle (Intellect, like Arcane Intellect), Greenhouse (Blueprint from Shadetooth, Excavation Site: Wetlands), Seed Hybridizer.
levelingTips: Gather nodes that are orange/yellow; pair with Alchemy.

name: Cooking
trainers: Learned through a special quest; cooking trainers in cities
changes: Every profession caps at 300 (Apprentice 75 / Journeyman 150 / Expert 225 / Artisan 300). No passive profession combat bonuses; Legacy perks Working Overtime (up to 5 ranks, +4% skill-up chance per the guide) and Dedicated Study (1 rank, daily: +1 skill to your lowest tradeskill, or 2-4 Elemental Essences once all are 300) apply. 37 new recipes (118 total). Crafted food now gives a small XP bonus plus stat buffs. Cooking makes the campfires: Basic Campfire (3 objects), Journeyman Campfire (5 objects; Blueprint from Lord Serpentis, Wailing Caverns), Expert Campfire (10 objects). Camp items Cookie's Feast (Blueprint from Cookie, The Deadmines) and Iron Oven. Legacy perk Master Chef gives a chance for extra food.
levelingTips: Level alongside Fishing; roughly 325-340 crafts to 300.

name: First Aid
trainers: Learned through a special quest; First Aid trainers in cities
changes: Every profession caps at 300 (Apprentice 75 / Journeyman 150 / Expert 225 / Artisan 300). No passive profession combat bonuses; Legacy perks Working Overtime (up to 5 ranks, +4% skill-up chance per the guide) and Dedicated Study (1 rank, daily: +1 skill to your lowest tradeskill, or 2-4 Elemental Essences once all are 300) apply. Heavily expanded: 8 new recipes (28 total) and the six standard Healing Potions (Minor to Major) moved here from Alchemy. New cures such as Woolen Tourniquet (bleeds) and Simple Poultice (disease). Camp objects: First Aid Kit (Stamina, like Power Word: Fortitude), Toxin Study (Blueprint from Commander Springvale, Shadowfang Keep), Plague Doctor's Laboratory.
levelingTips: Bandages still form the core; lets non-Alchemists make their own healing potions. Roughly 375-430 crafts to 300.

name: Fishing
trainers: Learned through a special quest; Expert rank comes from a book
changes: Every profession caps at 300 (Apprentice 75 / Journeyman 150 / Expert 225 / Artisan 300). No passive profession combat bonuses; Legacy perks Working Overtime (up to 5 ranks, +4% skill-up chance per the guide) and Dedicated Study (1 rank, daily: +1 skill to your lowest tradeskill, or 2-4 Elemental Essences once all are 300) apply. Legacy perk Luremaster: 25% chance for an extra fish while a lure is active. Camp objects: Fish Bowl (+8% stats, like Blessing of Kings), Fishing Rack (Blueprint from Gelihast, Blackfathom Deeps), Fishing Hut.
levelingTips: Pair with Cooking; use lures and fish in progressively higher zones.

name: Camping
trainers: Not a separate skill: campfires come from Cooking and each profession unlocks its own camp objects (tier 1 at skill 20 from trainers; tiers 2-3 from Blueprint drops in dungeons)
changes: New Forever system. Any player can place a campfire; nearby players each add one object from their profession (3/5/10 slots by fire size). Sit about a minute to get one-hour Camp Benefits; buffs are slightly weaker than and do not stack with the class buffs they mirror. Placing an object triggers a one-hour cooldown. Legacy perks Field Guide (shorter cooldown), Reagent Economy (free tier 1 objects) and Permanence (+50% buff duration) improve it.
levelingTips: Not leveled on its own; raise your professions to 140 and 300 and hunt Blueprints from dungeon bosses for upgraded objects.
